data.description:
Embark on a daily coding odyssey with my Dart-focused repository, a treasure trove of daily Dart code snippets and challenges. Tailored for Dart enthusiasts, Flutter aficionados, and those eager to master the Dart language, this repository is a curated collection of daily exercises aimed at honing my Dart skills and unleashing the power of Dart in various contexts.

key Points:

Diverse Dart Challenges: Immerse myself in a daily expedition of Dart challenges, carefully crafted to span the Dart language's capabilities. From fundamental language features to advanced Dart concepts, each day brings a new exploration.

Flutter Friendly: Experience a harmonious blend of pure Dart challenges and those tailored for Flutter. Explore how Dart seamlessly integrates with Flutter for building cross-platform, visually stunning applications.

Asynchronous Adventures: Delve into the world of asynchronous programming in Dart. Navigate through challenges that unravel the elegance and efficiency of Dart's asynchronous model.

Functional Flourishes: Embrace the functional programming paradigms of Dart. Witness the expressive power of Dart's functional features and explore how they contribute to clean and concise code.

Structured Codebase: Traverse a well-organized project structure where each day's code resides in its dedicated directory. Uncover daily insights, track my progression, and revisit code snippets effortlessly.
data.name: Dart

data.description:
Satellite Simulation Framework is an open-source project focused on developing a modular and extensible satellite simulation platform using Unreal Engine 5 and C++. The goal is to model satellite behavior, orbital mechanics, payloads, sensors, communication systems, and the space environment within a realistic, high-fidelity simulation.

This repository demonstrates the complete software engineering lifecycle behind building a professional simulation system. Development follows industry best practices, including systems engineering, software architecture, requirements management, documentation, issue tracking, Git workflows, code reviews, continuous integration (CI/CD), automated testing, and incremental feature development.

The project is organized around GitLab milestones, issues, feature branches, and merge requests to reflect the workflow of a professional engineering team. The architecture emphasizes modularity, scalability, maintainability, and future extensibility, enabling support for multiple satellite constellations, mission planning, visualization, AI-driven behaviors, and operator training.

This repository serves both as an educational resource and as a professional portfolio demonstrating software engineering, simulation development, and modern DevOps practices through the implementation of a complex, real-world simulation framework.
data.name: Satellite Simulator

data.description: SYSTEMIC AI FABRIC is a modular AGPL-3.0+ specification framework for designing and compiling regional AI systems. It enables jurisdictions to build AI infrastructure that is shaped by local conditions such as industry strengths, geography, regulation, and resource constraints. Rather than relying on universal models, the framework treats intelligence as a system that is generated, governed, and evolved within regional “natural labs,” producing adaptable and transparent AI architectures tailored to real-world environments.  https://roxanneardary.com/systemic-ai-fabric/
data.name: SYSTEMIC AI FABRIC

data.description: OpenDiagnose is an open-source, AGPL-3.0+ modular diagnostic system that turns real-world visual input into structured, actionable repair guidance. Using wearable or edge-connected vision hardware, interchangeable AI models, and domain-specific knowledge packs, it identifies faults across mechanical, electrical, agricultural, and infrastructure systems. Designed as a commons-driven platform, it separates hardware, software, and diagnostic logic into replaceable modules so the system can evolve without vendor lock-in or closed components.  https://roxanneardary.com/opendiagnose/
data.name: OpenDiagnose

data.description: OpenLeverage Lab is an open-source financial simulation engine that models margin borrowing, portfolio risk, and repayment dynamics under real-world uncertainty. It combines deterministic financial calculations with probabilistic stress testing, including Monte Carlo simulations and extreme market scenarios, to forecast leverage outcomes before capital is committed. Designed with a fully modular architecture, it enables transparent, reproducible, and extensible risk analysis for leveraged financial decision-making.  https://roxanneardary.com/openleverage-lab/
data.name: OpenLeverage Lab

data.description: SteadyMission is an open-source AI simulation and mission-alignment platform that helps organizations achieve business objectives without compromising their mission, values, or long-term direction. data.description: Axiomata is a constraint-driven neuro-symbolic geometry engine that transforms formal geometric systems into a generative space for structured creativity. By combining deterministic symbolic reasoning with neural construction proposal models, it explores, validates, and evolves geometric worlds through verifiable transformations. The system is designed to bridge logic and intuition, enabling the discovery of novel geometric structures within strictly defined formal constraints.  https://roxanneardary.com/axiomata/
data.name: Axiomata
